description.value:
You think fastest when it matters most, always keeping at least the outline of a plan in mind. Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You may use your Intelligence modifier in place of your Dexterity modifier for initiative checks, and you may make an Intelligence saving throw in place of a Dexterity saving throw. You can use this substitution a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all spent uses when you finish a long rest.
